### VF-045: a second Codex session opened the run-brief skill before working alone

[`2bf509bb2731`](https://github.com/pilifs/in-the-loop/commit/2bf509bb273106c43973bb249fdd1f4a625c87aa) · [log `f0aa93061306`](https://terminalvalue.net/raw-traces/01a1f5be-43bd-7532-a80c-5b4f5c304590/f0aa930613068d2b70e831cb8323eea106baf73a5897b049abd3da4b753c1212.jsonl.gz)
